title: glechoma biondiana
intro: Glechoma biondiana, commonly known as Italian creeping thyme, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Glechoma biondiana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions.
